description: Set the logged-in account's Note. ≤60-chars. Atop the DM inbox avatar, gone in 24h. Pushes you to the top of the DM list. Empty text clears it. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

text.description: Note text (≤60 chars). Empty or omitted clears the current note.

name: note_set
title: Note set
